# Disposable authoring examples {#sec-authoring-examples}

## Equations and the initial notation

The numbered display and reference below demonstrate native Quarto syntax.

$$
\theta_{n+1}
=
\theta_n+\gamma_{n+1}H(\theta_n,X_{n+1})
$$ {#eq-controlled-sa}

By @eq-controlled-sa, the update can also be written using `\SAupdate`.
The following displays record the intended notation only; hypotheses and
validity remain to be supplied in the research sections.

$$
\begin{aligned}
X_{n+1}\mid\cF_n
&\sim \Pkern{\theta_n}{X_n}{\cdot},
\\
\SAupdate,
\qquad \htheta &= \meanfieldtheta.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-controlled-notation}

$$
\Momentumupdate
$$ {#eq-momentum}

$$
\Momentumupdate
$$ {#eq-adam-m}

$$
\Secondmomentupdate
$$ {#eq-adam-v}

$$
\Adamupdate
$$ {#eq-adam-update}

$$
\Ftheta
=
\E_{\statlawtheta}
\left[
  \frac{\Mtheta}{\sqrt{\Vtheta}+\eps}
\right]
$$ {#eq-frozen-field}

Compare the source of @eq-controlled-notation and @eq-frozen-field with
their rendered output. For a measure-valued kernel use
$\Pkern{\theta_n}{X_n}{\dd x}$.
